Major Linux kernel release ships today

Filed by J. Reporter · 2 hours ago

Inside the new scheduler

The release brings changes to the sched_ext subsystem, letting developers plug in BPF-based schedulers without recompiling the kernel.

Core maintainers emphasised that the new APIs are experimental, but early benchmarks show latency improvements on mixed workloads.

Rust in the kernel expands

Rust support has landed for additional driver subsystems. The maintainers expect more drivers to migrate over the next two cycles.

“The safety wins are real,” said one contributor.

Benchmarks: database throughput up 12%

Synthetic benchmarks under PostgreSQL show a measurable throughput increase on NUMA systems with many cores.
